title: あなたと行きたい場所

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out together, Special Week and I return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm getting used to hanging out with you like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But there are still so many things I want us to do together! Like…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thinking about how you'd react to being on a roller coaster or in a haunted house really makes me wanna go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm not so good with scary things, but there's something about the thrill of it all…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, but don't you dare sneak up on me in the haunted house!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oooh, hiking! That didn't even cross my mind!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That'd definitely help me train both my body and soul!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Let's pack some lunches so we can eat while admiring the mountain scenery!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Leave lunch to me! You might not know this, but I make these great little sausages that look like octopuses! Hehe!
